answer_1.quote: We benchmark trlX on two popular RLHF tasks: OpenAI's learning to summarize TL;DR dataset ... and Anthropic's Helpful QA dataset ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries for TL;DR and helpful/harmless assistant responses

answer_2.quote: We attach a table in the appendix showing the result of the ROUGE scores in the test set of the TL;DR dataset of SFT and PPO trained on the 6.9B model ... test accuracy ... mean accuracy of each model class on the benchmarks.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation in which labelers choose between responses generated by a model and the comparably sized supervised fine‑tuned baseline ... we also collect Likert scores on a scale of 1‑7 for response Helpfulness, Harmfulness, and Honesty.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose the better summary and rate coverage, clarity, inconsistency on a 1‑7 Likert scale; also rate helpfulness, harmfulness, honesty.
